_note: Read 17 September 2026 from imandevelopers.com. The site pops up a name/email/phone enquiry form on load and the brochure is behind it - I did not fill it in and did not fetch anything behind it; the popup artwork /assets/images/popup/popupimg.jpg is excluded as furniture. Images are served from the developer's own WordPress backend at api.imandevelopers.com. The small amenity PNGs under /uploads/2025/04/ and /2025/05/ (Rooftop-Gym.png etc.) were measured at around 90x68 and are pictogram icons, so they are excluded. I downloaded and LOOKED at the elevations, the arrival drive and three interiors. This is the best-photographed of the four Iman pages - it publishes a genuine 3018x1694 wide elevation. FILENAME WARNING: 06_Living-rom.jpg is NOT an apartment living room - I looked at it and it is a double-height entrance LOBBY with a marble reception desk and a linear chandelier. No floor plans are published as images on this page.
